source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Flash System ROM to the same version with AMI flash tool for uEFI.
1. Send command: afuefix64.efi <BIOS filename> /P /B /N /ME
2. Reboot the system
3. Check version in BIOS setup menu and OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: AMI AFULnx or afuefix64.efi, image and reboot automation
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Assumes 100 upgrade/downgrade flashes and adds an AC cycle not present in source.
deepseek_columns.risk: Repeated BIOS writes may brick board.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes repeated destructive writes but guesses upgrade/downgrade semantics and adds an unsupported AC cycle.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; identifies irreconcilable title versus same-version procedure/criteria and missing sequence.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL before semantic conflict was fully evaluated.

original_test_intent: The title suggests a 100-operation BIOS upgrade/downgrade endurance test, but Procedure and Criteria define a same-version AFUEFI reflash and do not say whether 100 counts writes, alternating directions, pairs or complete cycles.
original_method: Do not execute. Preserve the title, Procedure and Criteria contradiction and require an owner-defined version/image sequence, iteration unit, reboot versus power behavior, per-cycle acceptance, stop policy and recovery before any destructive plan is constructed.
manual_activity: The owner must correct the destructive operation semantics; an engineer would also supervise console/BIOS Setup acceptance after correction. The agent cannot safely choose a 100-write sequence from conflicting source facts.
required_inputs: Definition of one iteration and whether 100 means flashes, directional operations or upgrade/downgrade pairs
Approved current/upgrade/downgrade or same-version images and exact order
Reboot versus any power-cycle rule and per-iteration readiness/acceptance
Abort threshold, recovery/rollback, stable power, OOB and final-state policy
safety_requirements: Perform no firmware write until semantics are corrected; this is not a missing-parameter-only condition.
Do not add DeepSeek's AC cycle or infer adjacent-case behavior.
After correction, validate every image/direction and stop on the first write, version, boot, ME/security or management fault.
No automatic retry or continuation after failure; never interrupt an active write.
Preserve all 100-iteration evidence and actual project override count.
agent_execution_scope: Record the contradiction, enumerate the decision fields and preserve all source evidence.
After owner correction, validate a fixed plan and prepare per-iteration evidence/stop controls.
Do not execute or claim a Tool Result while the current semantics remain unresolved.
engineer_actions: Correct the Master/approved project procedure for sequence, count, images and acceptance.
Approve/supervise the destructive loop and recovery plan once unambiguous.
Observe BIOS Setup evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe: it invents an AFULnx equivalent and AC cycle and assumes a sequence absent from source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the shown AFUEFI command only as source evidence; no executable loop may be recommended until the owner resolves semantics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Title's 100 count, same-version procedure/criteria, exact command/flags, reboot, BIOS/OS checks, script and 10/1000-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: NO MODERNIZED EXECUTION UNTIL SOURCE SEMANTICS ARE CORRECTED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After correction, use an immutable per-iteration manifest naming action, source/target image, tool/flags, write result, activation, BIOS/OS version, health and stop state.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record tool/image hashes, board revision, BIOS/ME, BMC and environment for the corrected plan.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform/AMI procedure and approved project cycle script after the owner supplies them.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Refuses to invent the missing destructive sequence; proposes evidence structure only.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One guessed interpretation could perform 100 unintended firmware writes and materially increase bricking risk.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve fewer than 100 operations, but must first define the source operation. Completion then applies only to the stated count and sequence and cannot claim original 100-cycle coverage.
expected_evidence: Owner-corrected semantics, iteration definition, exact version/image sequence and approval
Tool/image hashes, board compatibility, flags, power and recovery baseline
For every approved iteration: action, target, full AFU output, return code and activation
Per-iteration BIOS/OS version, health/events and stop status
Final state, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `Upgrade and downgrade for 100 times` conflicts with Procedure and Criteria that specify same-version reflash and contain no 100-iteration sequence. Direction, count unit and acceptance are materially ambiguous.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Choosing an interpretation would invent a high-risk destructive operation. Unlike missing artifacts or project parameters, the necessary operation semantics themselves are contradictory, so BLOCKED is justified pending an owner correction.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its guessed sequence, invented AC cycle and non-standard PARTIAL label.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with BLOCKED and retains the exact semantic/safety rationale.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates a genuine semantic block from ordinary package/approval readiness and records the decision without stopping unrelated reviews.

review_improvement: Prevents a guessed 100-cycle firmware loop and precisely lists the minimum owner decisions required to make it executable.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is not merely absent images or approval: the source simultaneously requires different destructive behaviors. Since sequence interpretation changes coverage and bricking exposure, safe automation cannot be defined until corrected.
